verdict.rationale: No evidence describes bulk select/edit/update across many incidents or alerts. The closest support is the migration tooling, which imports schedules and escalation policies from PagerDuty/Opsgenie in one go. Beyond that, an API and MCP server exist that could be scripted for multi-item actions, but the evidence never documents any bulk endpoints. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/resolve/update operations in UI, API, or MCP; bulk API endpoints; hands-on corroboration.
